Name: Chaosmod 2.3.0 non PG
Author: someoneElsHere
Description:
Hello! This is an addon to another mod that I can't publish because of copyright reasons and size. This mod is for Stardew Valley! It is mostly a joke mod. Use the chaosaddon folder inside as the mod addon, and the chaosaddon_content folder as the content pack!


This mod uses some bad language so uh, be old enough.

This will mod will add... *deep breath*

Events! Can happen randomly and effect your playthrough. Can be a whole host of things.

Curses! You can be stuck with a variety of curses, which will effect your playthrough.

New items!

New descriptions and prices for items! Yes I made a lot of things uh.. expensive.

....Plus a mechanic that increases luck and damage for clicking along the BPM.... (Not working probably, will edit when new update comes out

...You can date anyone that is of age and not married, but your pool of candidates is diffrent per save file.

(Note thar Clint is exempt from this due to the update coming)

Direction chests! You can automate stuff with these arrow shaped chests!

Plus cool tidbits you'll get in the mail!

....Annnnd a Lewis x Marnie scene that made this a non pg release. No nudity. 

The sexualized part is just a bad ms paint png of them making out sonic x Mario style. Ynow that one meme?

Yeah this is a lot.


(
1.This mod does use Harmony Patching for some aspects.
2. My code uses a lot of threads, so don't use this with a really bad cpu.
3. There are also some stalling issues possibly.
)

Thank you to...

Fireball, inspiration for the direction chests mod

Quinerna, for the idea of being able to date more people

Ih8lewis4ever for giving me the idea of the Lewis x Marnie section in the non pg mod

For more info, and the PG-13 ver, see the Stardew Valley Forms page!
